verdict.rationale: A natural-language interface, such as a chat assistant for filing or licensing, is a plausible feature for an online government tax portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows My DOR or dor.wa.gov accepting natural-language commands. The documented flows are click-through forms and wizards, and the jurisdiction type-to-filter field and the automated phone line are adjacent features that earn no credit. The probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec.
